# SceneNameDrawer

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Attribute/SceneNameDrawer.cs#L25)

Draws a [SceneName] string field as a picker over the scenes the next build would ship.

Which list that is depends on the selected build profile: a profile that overrides the
global scene list contributes its own, and every other case falls back to the global one.
That is the same choice Unity itself makes when it builds, so the picker can never offer
a scene the build would leave out, and switching the active profile changes what the
field offers. Only scenes ticked in the list are offered, because an unticked one is not
in the build and cannot be loaded by name.

A value that is not in the list is kept and called out rather than silently swapped for
another scene - the profile it belongs to may simply not be the selected one right now.

```csharp
[CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(SceneNameAttribute))]
public class SceneNameDrawer : PropertyDrawer
```
